name: abcls-cli
description: Command-line tool for ABC music notation

scripts.test: node esbuild.js && node dist/abcls.js --help > /dev/null && node dist/abcls.js transform tests/chords.abc transpose -- -2 | grep -q "\[V:1\]" && node dist/abcls.js harmonize tests/chords.abc --chords-from 1 --into 3,4,5,6 | grep -q "^\[V:6\]" && ! node dist/abcls.js transform tests/chords.abc transpose 2 --voice 9 2> /dev/null
